rationale: The side and angle audit logic is mathematically correct and the prose is appropriate for Grade 10, but the opening cx-combine-classify figure is only two lines of text and the coordinate-rich k1, k2, k3, and apex challenge do not show the triangles whose sides, slopes, and right angles are being classified. The current generator family also has an answer-explains-itself length flag. reopenCondition: Reassess after the classified triangles are visibly plotted in teaching, questions, and explanation states and the classify-triangle MCQs pass option parity; reopen on lesson, course, figure, geometric lab, generator, evaluator, standards, duplicate, or V4-contract change.

rationale: The layered parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus, and square tests are sound, and the quad-drag interaction gives one useful construction. The rest of the classification work relies mainly on coordinate strings and a generic quadrilateral rather than synchronized diagrams showing the measured side, diagonal, and slope evidence; the generator also has a length-parity flag. Learner-facing references such as “pq’s” and “the pq course” expose internal course shorthand instead of mature mathematical language, so both representation and wording require revision.
reopenCondition: Reassess after each classification claim is linked to a plotted, labeled figure and visible evidence table, all internal pq shorthand is replaced with explicit theorem names, and MCQ/notation findings close; reopen on source, renderer, generator, standards, duplicate, or V4-contract change.

rationale: The lesson’s goal—using variables, symmetry, and midpoint arguments to prove whole families—is valuable, but its visual contract is internally inconsistent. CxVariablesGeneral labels a rectangle with (2a, 2b) while the text uses (a, b), and c2 discusses symmetric placement while displaying the Varignon midpoint figure. The flagged general-proof MCQ has a 146-character option against a 45-character distractor, one radical row remains, and tm/pq shorthand leaks into learner feedback and hints. These are material visual, choice, notation, and language blockers.
reopenCondition: Reassess after every variable label and figure matches the stated general placement, Varignon and symmetry visuals are placed with their own claims, option parity and radical rendering pass, and internal course codes are removed; reopen on any source, figure, generator, renderer, standards, duplicate, or V4-contract change.

rationale: The perimeter progression, exact-radical emphasis, error feedback, and lap metaphor are clear for Grade 10, but most coordinate polygons are described rather than shown, so learners cannot inspect the boundary order, omitted side, or slanted distance on the question surface. In i1 the semantic model supplies an axis-aligned 3-by-3 square while separately declaring all side radicands as 18; the special renderer hides the contradictory points and draws only the radical labels. Value-synchronized polygon diagrams are required before this visual-first lesson can pass.
reopenCondition: Reassess after every perimeter task can be inspected on a value-synchronized ordered polygon and the radical-perimeter source contains one coherent geometric state; reopen on lesson, figure, coordinate-proof lab, evaluator, generator, standards, duplicate, or V4-contract change.

rationale: Box subtraction is a visual area method, yet the central k1 and k2 tasks give the bounding-box and corner numbers in prose without showing the actual triangle, box, or subtracted regions. The later boxAdvantage lab does draw a polygon, but its bounding box is withheld until the post-answer information state, so the representation does not carry the learner’s reasoning. References to “g7 formulas” also expose internal course shorthand. The method needs state-linked box and corner visuals throughout, with explicit Grade 10 wording.
reopenCondition: Reassess after the live triangle, bounding box, corner legs, and subtraction areas are visible during teaching and learner work, not only after reveal, and all g7 shorthand is replaced; reopen on source, figure, widget, generator, standards, duplicate, accessibility, or V4-contract change.

rationale: The numeric examples, boundary-order warning, reverse-order case, scrambled-path diagnosis, and pentagon transfer are mathematically coherent. The learner must infer the central geometric object from prose, and one radical expression remains outside the verified rendering boundary. The circle and tangency point must be shown in the live question and explanation.
